script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$r=[ordered]@{utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');vm_id='d5913cd7-aa99-4695-96b7-0d0135bad386'};try{$vm=Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\virtualization\v2 -Class Msvm_ComputerSystem -Filter "Name='D5913CD7-AA99-4695-96B7-0D0135BAD386'";$settings=@($vm.GetRelated('Msvm_VirtualSystemSettingData')|Where-Object {$_.VirtualSystemType -eq 'Microsoft:Hyper-V:System:Realized'})[0];$svc=Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\virtualization\v2 -Class Msvm_VirtualSystemManagementService;$img=$svc.GetVirtualSystemThumbnailImage($settings.__PATH,1024,768);$r.return_value=$img.ReturnValue;$r.bytes=$img.ImageData.Length;if($img.ReturnValue -ne 0){throw 'Thumbnail request failed'};Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing;$bmp=New-Object Drawing.Bitmap(1024,768,[Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format16bppRgb565);$rect=New-Object Drawing.Rectangle(0,0,1024,768);$bits=$bmp.LockBits($rect,[Drawing.Imaging.ImageLockMode]::WriteOnly,[Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format16bppRgb565);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy([byte[]]$img.ImageData,0,$bits.Scan0,$img.ImageData.Length);$bmp.UnlockBits($bits);$bmp.Save('C:\Users\Public\src001-vm-console-20260916.png',[Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png);$bmp.Dispose();$r.result='PASS'}catch{$r.result='ERROR';$r.error=$_.Exception.Message};$r|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content 'C:\Users\Public\src001-vm-console-receipt-20260916.json' -Encoding UTF8
